verdicts.reason: A scrambles the numbered steps (4 and 3 at far left, 1 in the centre, 2 stranded at the far right), so the list reads out of order, and its step text is tiny. The logo is pushed to the far right while the headline sits in the middle, and the CTA is small and wedged between the steps. B keeps the headline-to-steps-to-CTA order and gives the CTA real weight. But its steps are spread out in a diamond instead of one tidy block, the logo above the headline is so small it can't be read, the jar is cut off at the right edge, and the step text is still very small.
